name: Art Gallery of Ballarat

facts.claim: Oldest regional art gallery in Australia, founded in 1884
Housed in an 1890 building on Lydiard Street North

access_note: Main building at 40 Lydiard St Nth is closed for building upgrades; exhibitions are at Backspace Gallery, 43 Mair St (official site, 2026-11-02).

name: Lake Wendouree

facts.claim: Shallow artificial urban lake beside the suburb of Wendouree in Ballarat
Name comes from a local Aboriginal word wendaaree, meaning 'go away'
Heritage trams of the Ballarat Tramway Museum run along its shore

ticketUrl_note: Managed by City of Ballarat (council parks page not found); no single steward site verified

name: Ballarat Botanical Gardens

facts.claim: 40-hectare reserve on the western shore of Lake Wendouree
Three zones: a central Victorian 'gardenesque' garden flanked by North and South Gardens

ticketUrl_note: City of Ballarat parks page deep link not confirmed (listed in council nav under Parks and Sportsgrounds at https://www.ballarat.vic.gov.au/); not verified
unresolved: council page for the gardens not located; free entry from Wikipedia silence only, unverified

name: Ballarat Wildlife Park

facts.claim: Zoo opened in February 1985 on 10 hectares
Holds over 300 animals including over 100 free-roaming kangaroos
Large reptile collection; hand-feeding kangaroos and koalas offered

access_note: Adult $42 at the gate; online price lower (~$37.80).

name: Kryal Castle

facts.claim: Replica medieval castle 8 km east of Ballarat at Leigh Creek, in the foothills of Mount Warrenheip
Offers overnight stays in castle rooms, cabins and tiny homes

unresolved: homepage says "Tickets from only $31.50"; adult general-admission price not confirmed on a tickets page (buy-tickets URL 404)

name: Ballarat Tramway Museum

facts.claim: Heritage trams run on part of the original horse tramway around Lake Wendouree and the Botanical Gardens
Trams ran across Ballarat from 1887 until 1971; the museum holds an archive of 3,500+ items

access_note: Runs on weekends and public holidays (per official site); adult $15.
